news.headline: JPMorgan Initiates Coverage on Nektar Therapeutics with Neutral Rating and $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan started NKTR at Neutral with a $65 price target, below the prior close and the second cautious initiation after Wedbush's $80. It sits far under the Moderate Buy consensus target of roughly $141-153, where Piper Sandler is highest at $192.

news.headline: Earnings Update: Here's Why Analysts Just Lifted Their Nektar Therapeutics Price Target To US$153
news.summary: Following the Q2 print, the sell-side consensus target moved up to roughly $153, with B. Riley raising to $150 from $105, Citi reaffirming $151 and Piper Sandler holding $192. That left the average target roughly double a share price then near $76.

news.headline: Two Seas Capital Discloses 9.1% Stake in Nektar Therapeutics
news.summary: Two Seas Capital LP and affiliated funds reported beneficial ownership of 3,092,234 NKTR shares (9.1% of the class), up 57.8% quarter over quarter after adding roughly 1.1 million shares in Q2 2026 for about $79 million. It ranks the fund among Nektar's largest institutional holders alongside Vanguard and RA Capital.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Stock Slides As Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Quarterly revenue fell 9.4% year over year to $10.13 million while the trailing 12-month net loss widened 28.5% to $157.13 million, keeping the focus on burn as the Phase 3 program ramps. The stock slipped about 4% on the print and drifted lower afterward despite a large EPS beat.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026 versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, helped by the April equity offering, extending runway into Q3 2028 and past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout; net loss narrowed to $40.6 million ($1.23/share) on revenue of $10.1 million. Management confirmed ZENITH AD-3 would start in September 2026, guided to 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata data in Q4 2026, and noted the Eli Lilly breach-of-contract jury trial is set to begin September 8, 2026.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar started ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, two 510-patient global registrational trials in biologic/JAK-naive patients aged 12 and older, part of a roughly 1,530-patient program with a third study in treatment-experienced patients (ZENITH AD-3) to follow in September. The design followed FDA end-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice, targeting topline data in mid-2028 and a BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third roughly 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor experience, is guided to begin in September 2026, completing the registrational package for U.S. and European filings.

catalysts.label: Eli Lilly breach-of-contract jury trial begins
catalysts.detail: A jury trial in Nektar's contract dispute with Eli Lilly over their collaboration is scheduled to start September 8, 2026 in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California; Lilly's summary-judgment motion was denied in March 2026. CEO Howard Robin flagged the date on the Q2 2026 earnings call as an event to watch.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AD / REZOLVE-AA data at EADV Congress 2026 (Vienna)
catalysts.detail: Two oral presentations are on the EADV Congress 2026 schedule (Vienna, September 30-October 3): Dr. Thomas Bieber presenting deepening/durable REZOLVE-AD maintenance responses with monthly vs quarterly dosing, and Dr. David Rosmain presenting 52-week REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata efficacy and safety data. Durability of the Treg effect is a key swing factor ahead of the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3 start.

catalysts.label: Long-term off-treatment durability data
catalysts.detail: Management guided on the Q2 2026 call to 24-week off-treatment alopecia areata data in Q4 2026 and 52-week off-treatment atopic dermatitis data in Q1 2027, both intended to inform long-term maintenance dosing strategy for the Phase 3 programs.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report should update cash burn against year-end guidance of $815-840 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start and early enrollment across all three ZENITH AD studies, and give an update on the Lilly litigation outcome. Date is a consensus estimate; Nektar has not yet issued a formal announcement.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 study in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept data (28.2% mean SALT reduction on high dose vs 11.2% placebo at 36 weeks). Rezpeg already holds FDA Fast Track in this indication.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway now extends into Q3 2028, covering this readout without a further raise.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Nektar has publicly guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in 2029, following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The program was designed with parallel EMA scientific advice, so a European filing is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: Nektar remains a pure late-stage rezpeg story with its funding question largely answered: Q2 2026 (reported August 13) showed $1.02 billion in cash and runway into Q3 2028, past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout, with ZENITH AD-3 due to start in September 2026. The print was mixed - a big EPS beat but revenue of $10.1 million slightly light and trailing losses still widening on the Phase 3 ramp - and the stock has drifted into the mid-$70s, well below its 52-week high near $109, even as institutional conviction firmed (Two Seas Capital lifted its stake to 9.1%) and sell-side targets rose (consensus near $141-153) alongside a new, more cautious JPMorgan Neutral/$65 initiation. Near-term attention is split between the September 8 Eli Lilly breach-of-contract jury trial, ZENITH AD-3's September start, and the REZOLVE-AD/REZOLVE-AA oral presentations at EADV Congress 2026 in Vienna (September 30-October 3), which should show how durable the Treg effect is ahead of the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3 start.
